term: respect of change (substance, quantity, quality, place)
definition: `OfChange r`: r is a respect in which a moved thing is otherwise and otherwise: substance (generation and corruption), quantity (growth and diminution), quality (alteration) or place (locomotion) (In Metaph. XII, lect. 7 n. 12). A Lean parameter of the Lambda.7 readings, which read 'in no way' over these respects only. It adds substance to DEF-PHYSICAL-RESPECT (motion in the strict sense of Physics V). Every respect of change is a respect (DEF-RESPECT); the converse is the open bridge STMT-UNCHANGEABLE-IN-RESPECTS-OF-CHANGE-IS-UNCHANGEABLE-SIMPLY.
